item.title: Arkansas Inmates Restricted from Receiving Physical Books & Other Media Under New Policy
item.description: WHITE HALL, ARKANSAS- Taking effect on February 1st, Arkansas inmates will no longer be able to receive books, newspapers, or magazines. item.title: Gatewood Woman Injured in Oregon County
item.description: A 76-year-old Gatewood woman received moderate injuries in an accident on Highway 142 in Oregon County on Friday. The accident occurred when she ran off the right side of the roadway, overcorrected, ran off the left side and overturned. She was airlifted to Mercy in Springfield for treatment.
